headline: Capita CEO Resigns as Shares Crash 67% Following Pension Payment Delays
summary: Capita chief executive Adolfo Hernandez stepped down with immediate effect after accepting responsibility for civil service pension payment delays. Shares of the UK outsourcing group plunged 67%.
why: Capita is a major British business process outsourcing and professional services company that manages significant public sector contracts in the UK.

impacts.name: Capita plc
impacts.why: Capita's stock crashed 67% after its CEO abruptly departed following delays in civil service pension payments.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Capita shares plunged 67% after chief executive Adolfo Hernandez resigned immediately due to ongoing delays in processing civil service pension payments.
